backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor with user profiles, pets, videos, categories, and authorization/storage mixins plus helper functions.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries linking features to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing many frontend files’ functionality and fixes.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React router, routes, and auth/admin guards for the application.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminVideo: Admin UI component for selecting categories/breeds/health topics and managing associated video links.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlobImageU: Image uploader with preview, validation, and upload progress using ExternalBlob. Allows clearing images and notifies parent on selection.
frontend/src/components/ai/behavior/Beha: UI flow to collect pet behavior inputs and display an AI-generated health assessment with explanations and next steps.
frontend/src/components/ai/breed/BreedId: Developer tool that runs automated breed-identification test cases and displays pass/fail results with confidence.
Tool for uploading a pet image, optionally adding a hint, and showing breed-identification results with confidence and explanation.
frontend/src/components/ai/emergency/Eme: Step-by-step triage form collecting symptom details and showing an AI emergency assessment with urgency and recommended actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Protects admin-only routes by checking user role and showing an access-denied screen if not authorized.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication guard that redirects unauthenticated users to login and shows a loading state while identity initializes.
frontend/src/components/common/CatalogIm: Image component with automatic fallback image handling on load errors.
frontend/src/components/common/SectionCa: Wrapper card component supporting optional title and description with flexible content.
frontend/src/components/favorites/Favori: Toggle button to add or remove a video or breed from favorites using identity checks and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps pages with a navbar, footer, and main content layout.
frontend/src/components/media/CatalogIma: Image component that swaps to a fallback source on load error.
frontend/src/components/media/YouTubeEmb: Displays a YouTube video embed with title and optional favorite button, falling back to a link if no ID is found.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Renders a breadcrumb trail with home link and optional navigable items.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Foote: Static footer showing credits and a disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Responsive navigation bar handling authentication, admin links, and mobile menu toggling.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Dashb: Form workflow to create an initial pet profile and optional vaccination entry.
frontend/src/components/profile/Favorite: Manages and displays saved favorite videos with removal and profile initialization logic.
frontend/src/components/profile/PetsMana: CRUD interface for managing a user's pets, including editing, photos, and profile creation fallback.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileE: React component allowing users to view and edit their profile info including name, email, and profile photo, with save logic and loading states.
frontend/src/components/profile/Vaccinat: Component for managing pet vaccination records, including adding vaccinations, marking completion, and ensuring a profile exists.
frontend/src/content/health/healthCatalo: Static catalog defining health categories and topics with symptoms, causes, prevention, and video resources.
Static dataset listing pet breeds with descriptions, care tips, health issues, and related videos.
frontend/src/content/pets/petsCatalog.ts: Defines pet categories and subcategories with pet info, care instructions, and video links.
frontend/src/content/recommendations.ts: Provides daily rotating care tips and a list of recommended pet care videos.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity, auto-refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminVideos.ts: React-query hooks that fetch and manage admin video links, supporting create, update, and delete operations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerRole.ts: Hook that checks if the logged-in caller is an admin using actor.isCallerAdmin and exposes loading and state flags.
Provides queries and mutations for pet categories and breeds, enabling CRUD operations with react‑query cache updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and auth-client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains user-focused queries and mutations for profiles, pets, vaccinations, favorites, and videos with cache updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useVaccinationDueToda: Hook that shows a live countdown to end of day when user is authenticated.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode colors, base styles, and reusable component classes.
Simple rules engine scoring pet behavior inputs to return a low/medium/high concern assessment with guidance.
Implements token-based breed matching from filenames and optional hints, returning the best-scoring breed with confidence and explanation.
frontend/src/lib/ai/breedIdentificationT: Defines structured test cases for validating breed identification logic across filenames, hints, and expected outputs.
frontend/src/lib/ai/emergencyTriageRules: Provides simple rule-based triage that classifies pet symptoms into high, medium, or low urgency with recommended actions.
frontend/src/lib/vaccinationReminders.ts: Generates vaccination reminder messages based on due dates and includes utilities for day-end countdown and time formatting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBreedsPage: Admin UI for listing, adding, editing, and deleting breeds with image and video management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories: Admin interface to create, edit, and remove pet categories, including images and videos.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLandingPag: Dashboard page linking to admin sections for categories, breeds, and videos.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminVideosPage: Admin tool to manage video links tied to breeds, categories, or health topics with add/edit/delete support.
frontend/src/pages/ai/AIAssistantPage.ts: Main AI assistant page with tabs for emergency triage, health assessment, and breed identification.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPa: Explains Internet Identity recovery steps and links to the official recovery page.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity authentication with redirect on successful sign‑in.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignupPage.tsx: Signup page using Internet Identity login, showing benefits and redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the user dashboard, handling loading, authentication, onboarding, pet data, reminders, and recommended content.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCareLand: Landing page listing health categories with icons and links to detailed sections.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCategory: Displays a selected health category with its description and links to its topics.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthTopicPag: Renders detailed information for a health topic, including symptoms, causes, care steps, and related videos.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the landing page with hero section, feature descriptions, and links to sign up, dashboard, or AI assistant.
Shows a breed's details, image, description, optional attributes, and related videos, supporting backend or static data.
frontend/src/pages/pets/BreedListPage.ts: Lists breeds for a category using backend or static data, each linking to its detailed page.
Displays details for a pet category, optional image, breed links, and subcategories with pet buttons.
frontend/src/pages/pets/PetDetailPage.ts: Displays detailed information for a selected pet, including description, care requirements, videos, and quick facts.
Shows a grid of pet categories using backend data when available, falling back to static categories with icons and images.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Provides a tabbed profile interface for editing user info, managing pets, vaccinations, and favorites.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, plugins, animations, and color variables for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Stores metadata about the project state, features, requests, and deployment context for the PetGuide Admin app.
